title: Inheritance Strategy in EF Core
description: Overview of TPH, TPT, and TPC inheritance mapping strategies.

data.text: Inheritance lets you model **"is-a"** relationships. EF Core supports three strategies to map inheritance hierarchies to relational tables: **TPH**, **TPT**, and **TPC**.

data.title: Example Hierarchy
data.content: Animal base class with Cat and Dog derived classes

items: **TPC** - Prefer to avoid JOINs and accept duplication

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Three inheritance strategies: TPH, TPT, TPC
